text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A cantilever tip load creates constant shear and a linearly varying bending moment

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned elastic cantilever with downward tip load and rectangular section. Internal sign convention gives V−1 kN,M=−P(L−x). At the wall, normal bending
stress varies linearly across depth, zero at the neutral axis and equal/opposite at extreme fibers. Shear stress has a different cross-section
